en.authority: Ministry of Taxes and Duties of the Republic of Belarus
en.text:
Article 10 — Dividends

Application of Article 10 of the Czech Republic–Belarus tax treaty is suspended for the period from 1 June 2024 through 31 December 2026. The Czech Republic applies reciprocal non-application for the same period.

en.authority: Ministry of Taxes and Duties of the Republic of Belarus
en.text:
Article 11 — Interest

Application of Article 11 of the Czech Republic–Belarus tax treaty is suspended for the period from 1 June 2024 through 31 December 2026. The Czech Republic applies reciprocal non-application for the same period.

en.authority: Czech official treaty publication; English rendering for web display
en.text:
Article 12 — Royalties

Royalties arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State. They may also be taxed in the State in which they arise, but where the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties, the tax charged in the source State shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties. This English wording is a non-authentic translation for web display; the official treaty text controls.
